title: Open Trestle Secret Scan Request v1
description: Closed request contract for one bounded secret scan. Source ordinals are host-local and carry no path or repository identity.

request_id.description: A host-generated random request identifier that is not derived from source content.

sources.description: Runtime parsing requires contiguous ordinals and limits the decoded aggregate to 2 MiB.

ordinal.description: A contiguous zero-based position in this request.

content_base64.description: Standard padded base64 for at most 256 KiB of copied field bytes.
